name: dropshipzone_au-mcp
description: Dropshipzone (AU) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order, tr

platform_mcp_dropshipzone_au_email.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DROPSHIPZONE_AU_EMAIL
platform_mcp_dropshipzone_au_email.description: Dropshipzone API user e-mail; POST /auth {email, password} returns a token valid 15 minutes, sent as `Authorization: jwt <token>` and renewed automatically.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Dropshipzone has no account endpoint; the probe logs in and lists the categories ([{category_id, title, parent_id, path}]), so `account` is empty on success.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /v2/products {result[{entity_id, sku, title, price, cost, RrpPrice, currency (AUD), stock_qty, status, gallery[], website_url, Category, brand, desc}], total, total_pages, current_page}. `query` is `keywords` (comma-separated, up to 20), `category` is category_id; the page size must be between 40 and 200 (default 40). `id` is the SKU (get_product and orders use SKUs).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /v2/products?skus={id}: the first result for that SKU ({sku, title, price, stock_qty, gallery, desc, weight, length, width, height, ...}); an unknown SKU is an empty result (invalid_input).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /placingOrder creates a 'Not Submitted' order that is only charged once paid on the Dropshipzone website. `shipping_address` uses Dropshipzone's consignee keys {first_name, last_name, address1, address2, suburb, state, postcode, telephone, comment} (Australian addresses); `items` are order_items [{sku, qty}]; your_order_no is a fresh UUID. The API answers HTTP 200 with [{status, serial_number, errmsg}]: result_status 1 is success, -1 a rejection explained in `errmsg`. `shipping_option` is not sent (no such field).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /orders?order_ids={id} (Dropshipzone order id): data[{increment_id, serial_number, status (unpaid, pending, processing, complete, canceled), created_at, grand_total (decimal string, AUD), items, shipment[{track_number, title, created_at}], shipping_address}].

tools.name: track
tools.description: The shipment[{track_number, title (carrier), created_at}] list of GET /orders?order_ids={order_id}; empty until the order is dispatched.
